title: Reflective Essay
description: A short personal essay reflecting on what you learned and how your thinking changed.
instructions:
Write a 500–800 word reflective essay about your learning in this unit.

Your essay should cover three things:

  • What you learned — pick the two or three ideas that mattered most to you.
  • How your thinking changed — describe something you believed or assumed before that you now see differently.
  • What you'll do next — one concrete way you will apply this learning.

Write in the first person. There are no wrong answers here — the goal is honest, specific reflection, not summary.
grading_guidelines:
Grading looks for:

  • Specific, concrete examples rather than generalities (40%)
  • Evidence of genuine reflection — a before/after in your thinking (40%)
  • Clear, organized writing (20%)
